title: •Don’t Do That Again
caption: •Don’t Do That Again (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.
lore: The Jedi won’t tolerate silly behavior for very long.

(the PDF text layer reads "▲an" with no space; the slip image shows a space). Curly apostrophe in the heading/caption Don’t. Heading and caption •Don’t Do That Again (V), dots match the base. Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in won’t (wiki straight; at 350 px the glyph shape is not certain — set curly per Decipher typesetting). Copyright: Tatooine 2001 SE-style line with the year after the first ©, partly legible on the 350 px scan. Base top half prints a gold disc icon (looks like the Republic icon; low-res) and the Episode I icon under the destiny (kept from the printed card). Modern file VSh-L-dontdothatagain-pre.gif is the PC’s later Virtual Shields remake with DIFFERENT game text (adds the “Missing” clause) — art reference only. Art from the base scan, not the modern VSh shield face: the shield frame's art window is narrower and left a cyan strip down the right edge of the art box.
